name: clickhouse
title: ClickHouse
description: Interact with ClickHouse, the high-performance columnar OLAP database, for high-throughput ingestion and OLAP queries.
label: database,bigdata

properties.name: database
properties.description: The ClickHouse database. A table may also be provided using the database.table syntax.

properties.name: asyncInsert
properties.description: Whether to use ClickHouse server-side asynchronous inserts (async_insert=1).

properties.name: batchSize
properties.description: The client-side batch size for insert operations when the message body is a List. When greater than 0, the list is split into batches of this size and each batch is sent as a separate insert. A value of 0 (default) inserts the whole list in a single call.

properties.name: compression
properties.description: Whether to compress the insert request payload sent to the server (LZ4).

properties.name: format
properties.description: The ClickHouse data format used for insert and query operations, e.g. JSONEachRow, RowBinary, CSV, TSV or Parquet.

properties.name: operation
properties.description: The operation to perform: insert, query or ping.

properties.name: serverUrl
properties.description: The ClickHouse HTTP endpoint URL, e.g. http://localhost:8123. Required unless a shared Client bean is autowired or configured on the component.

properties.name: table
properties.description: The target table for insert operations. Can also be given in the path as database.table or overridden per message with the CamelClickHouseTable header.

properties.name: waitForAsyncInsert
properties.description: When asyncInsert is enabled, whether the server should wait for the async insert to be flushed before acknowledging (wait_for_async_insert).

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: password
properties.label: security
properties.description: The password used to authenticate to ClickHouse.

properties.name: ssl
properties.label: security
properties.description: Whether to connect to ClickHouse over a secure (HTTPS) connection.

properties.name: username
properties.label: security
properties.description: The username used to authenticate to ClickHouse.
